notes.title: map update
notes.content:
updated to unreal engine version 5.2
new map: yard
smoother animation transitions after grinding
added automatic rotation on air if not over 180 degrees (cool flips)
smoother rotations when ending grind for stair rails
removed rail balance system (it was bad)
fixed bug where you couldnt move on options after using customize screen
when bailing, skateboard will bounce around
player can now walk up stairs
player can do firecracker down stairs

notes.title: upcoming update
notes.content:
hello, its been a while since last update, ive been away from game development. i will release new small game on august, but lets talk about Grind.

i love this project, and been thinking about it last few days. today i opened the project files and started play with it again. it was fun. heres a list some things that will be on the next update.

- unreal engine version 5.2. game will be updated to latest unreal version. i want to keep this project fresh with new tools available, and have it as a place where i can always return.

- code cleaning. i will do some cleaning and optimizing the code for best performance.

- removed rail balance mechanic. balance mechanic is removed because it wasnt done right, it was a bit clunky, i dont know if this will be added back in the future.

- new map. i know that everyone doesnt like map creation. grind is built around that now, you have to set every obstacle and skate then. there will be a map/maps so you can just hop on without thinking to build everything.

i started streaming last year, i play different games and stream game development, come to say hi on
www.twitch.tv/kimssoon, will stream the development of grind there.

notes.content:
This was requested from community.
Tricklist added to options menu. all tricks are from regular stance, for goofy stance everything is flipped.

notes.content: bug fix: grip tape rotations on wallbounce, grinding and manuals

notes.title: New engine version
notes.content:
game is running now with unreal engine 5
(unreal engine 5 is currently on early access state so crashes can happen)
controls moved to options
fixed jump or push during pause
fixed editor part switching during pause
fixed camera stays down when hitting a wall with manual

notes.title: Board contest
notes.content:
Board - artwork contest!

you want to make your own board into the game? now you can do it.
use your Photoshop or Gimp skills to make one, zip file has files for both of the softwares.

board doesnt need to be super high quality

i dont know how to choose the best boards yet, maybe strawpoll or then i just choose them. well see.

link for the zip file:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I9RHrmpRQ6yl6wzqMGet7Ogkm_DCrv9u/view?usp=sharing

email your board(s) to "random.creations.tmi@gmail.com" with title "board contest" and add your board file into the email. anything else than image files or something else than boards will be removed immediately.

export images to png file!

coolest boards will be added into the game!

notes.title: Frame limit
notes.content: frame limit is now added into options. previously there was no limit and frames were running high and using gpu 100%. frame limit now drops the usage.
